procedure calc_new_expiry_date (p_product_code in VARCHAR2,
 p_attr_group in VARCHAR2,
 p_attr_code in VARCHAR2,
 p_proc_date in date,
 p_new_expdate out date)
is
 temp_life_span_ind VARCHAR2(1);
 v_local_time date;
 v_sysdate date; 
begin
 -- time zone change --5/11/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 
 select decode(life_span_ind,'D', p_proc_date + life_span,
 'Y',add_months(nvl(p_proc_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')),
 life_span * 12),
 'H',nvl(p_proc_date,v_sysdate)+(life_span / 24)),
 life_span_ind
 into p_new_expdate,temp_life_span_ind
 from valid_product_attributes
 where product_type = :ctrl_blk_1.product_type 
 and attrib_group = p_attr_group
 and attrib_code = p_attr_code
 and life_span is not null
 and life_span_ind is not null
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'))
 AND not exists
 (SELECT 'x' FROM valid_exp_date_ovr
 WHERE attrib_code = p_attr_code
 AND OVR_ATTRIB_CODE in 
 (SELECT attrib_code FROM component_attributes
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 AND product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.old_product_code
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) 
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id)
 AND v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'))
 );
 if temp_life_span_ind != 'H'
 then
 p_new_expdate := 
 to_date(to_char(p_new_expdate,'mmddyyyy')||'235959','mmddyyyyhh24miss') ;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 p_new_expdate := :expiry_date;
end;

 ,LV_ATTR_CODE

 ,P_PROGRAM_ID
 ,P_PROC_DATE --PERFORM COMMIT HAS SYSDATE - CHANGED TO PROC_DATE FOR IM.
 );
 
 End if;
 
 EXCEPTION

 END;

 IF lv_inter_code is not null then 
 Begin

 from component_interdictions

 and product_code = P_PRODUCT_CODE
 and inter_code=LV_INTER_CODE ;
 
 If nExists = 0 then 
 
 --insert into component_interdictions
 INSERT INTO COMPONENT_INTERDICTIONS ( 
 UNIT_ID
 , COLL_DATE
 , CHAPTER_ID
 , PRODUCT_CODE
 , INTER_CODE
 , INSERT_DATS
 , INTER_USER_ID
 , AUDIT_KEY

 VALUES (P_UNIT_ID
 ,P_COLL_DATE
 ,P_CHAPTER_ID

 ,sysdate

 ,AUDIT_SEQ.NEXTVAL --AUDIT KEY
 ,P_PROGRAM_ID);
 
 --COMMIT;

 END IF;
 
--COMMIT;

 -- Strip out the first attrib code from the string
 If comma_pos = 0 then

 Else

 End if;

 Exception -- for attribute chk

End Loop;
